milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green glazed terracotta pillar is at spawn-relative (-6, 1, -3). Player must navigate near it and face it. Max_distance=5 ensures meaningful verification in this compact ~16-block scene. Facing_tolerance=60° requires the player to actually look at the pillar.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Seagrass is underwater at spawn-relative (6, -1, 2) in a small pond at Y=-1 (below ground level). Facing_tolerance=90° accounts for the downward viewing angle needed to see underwater seagrass. Max_distance=5 ensures the player is actually at the pond edge.

Uses inventory_has because crafting melon seeds (1 melon_slice → 1 melon_seeds, shapeless recipe usable in 2x2 inventory grid) results in melon_seeds appearing in inventory. Player starts with 0 melon_seeds and 1 melon_slice, so any melon_seeds presence confirms crafting occurred.

Uses inventory_has because mining cyan terracotta with an iron pickaxe drops the cyan_terracotta item into inventory. The cyan terracotta blocks are the sole breakable entrance to the sealed bedrock chamber. Player starts with 0 cyan_terracotta, so any presence confirms mining occurred.

Uses inventory_has because mining white concrete with an iron pickaxe drops the white_concrete item into inventory. White concrete is the second layer inside the sealed bedrock chamber, only accessible after mining through cyan terracotta. Player starts with 0 white_concrete.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jungle trapdoor drops the jungle_trapdoor item into inventory. The trapdoor is on the back wall of the sealed chamber at (-3, 1, -6), only accessible after mining through both cyan terracotta and white concrete layers. Player starts with 0 jungle_trapdoors.

Uses inventory_has because mining a crafting table with an axe drops the crafting_table item into inventory. The crafting table is freestanding at (5, 0, -1). Player starts with 0 crafting_tables, so any presence confirms mining occurred.

Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia doors (6 acacia planks in 2x3 pattern on a 3x3 crafting table grid) results in acacia_door items in inventory. Using min_count=1 rather than 3 (full recipe output) to safely handle the case where the player places some doors before the milestone is checked. Player starts with 0 acacia_doors.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smooth quartz stairs form the front face of the southern alcove structure at spawn-relative (3, 0, 5). Max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked to the south side. Facing_tolerance=60° requires looking at the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because opening the barrel and retrieving its contents results in baked_potato appearing in inventory. The barrel at (3, 0, 7) inside the quartz alcove contains 3 baked_potatoes and is the only source of baked_potato in the scene. Player starts with 0 baked_potatoes, so any presence confirms the barrel was opened and items retrieved.
